dedupe_keys.name: gridded dataset of nitrogen and phosphorus point sources from wastewater in germany 1950 2019

description: A Helmholtz research team publishes Germany-wide nitrogen and phosphorus point-source estimates from wastewater for 1950–2019. Zenodo provides gridded and basin-level archives plus calibration inputs and a detailed README under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The files split decades and spatial aggregations, connecting wastewater-treatment and population history to nutrient-emission estimates. These data can parameterise wastewater discharge, receiving-water quality and long-term infrastructure scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this historical point-source product. Coverage is Germany across seven decades, not direct measurements at every plant or a modern live effluent feed. A limitation is that the derived emissions depend on household, detergent, food and treatment assumptions and multiple upstream licences; the README explains the noncommercial share-alike terms. Grid, basin and plant-derived values should not be mixed without checking units. No archive was downloaded or mass balance recalculated.
